answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming at the gate. Every agent must anchor a 60-credit deposit to claim one slot on the work terrace; the deposit burns if the slot sits idle or the work fails audit. An attacker spinning a nebula of 1,000 fake identities must burn 60,000 credits up front, while honest agents pay once, complete real work, and earn the deposit back plus fees. Forging identities becomes a money pit, not free scale.
